lessons.title: 1. Assert Helpers
lessons.description: Write `assert_equal(actual, expected)` that raises AssertionError with a clear message on mismatch.
learning_objectives: Raise AssertionError with a helpful message

tests.name: test_assert_equal
tests.unittest_code:
def test_assert_equal(self):
    assert_equal(1, 1)
    with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
        assert_equal(1, 2)

lessons.title: 3. Fixture-like Setup (Concept Challenge)
lessons.description: Build `with_temp_dict(factory)` that creates a dict via factory, yields it to a callback, then clears it.
lessons.solution_code:
def with_temp_dict(factory, callback):
    data = factory()
    callback(data)
    data.clear()
    return data

tests.name: test_with_temp_dict

lessons.title: 4. Approximate Float Compare (Practice)
lessons.description: Implement `approx_equal(a, b, tol=1e-6)` for float comparisons in tests: two numbers count as equal when their distance is within `tol`.
lessons.solution_code:
def approx_equal(a, b, tol=1e-6):
    return abs(a - b) <= tol

tests.name: test_approx
